requirement: Confirm the actual phone/OS pair. Apple’s September 2026 update article supports Ultra 2 on watchOS 27; it requires iPhone 11+ or SE 2nd generation+ on iOS 27. Original launch minima are a different question.
acceptance: Record actual iPhone model, iOS, watchOS and successful system pairing.

requirement: Use the system Apple Watch pairing/setup flow; app connectivity is a separate companion-app layer.
acceptance: Distinguish unpaired, app absent, activating, ready, disconnected and errors.

requirement: Create iOS and watchOS app targets with matching companion bundle relationship, signing and embedding.
acceptance: Archive and install both correctly signed apps on the paired devices.

requirement: An independent Watch app must obtain essential data independently rather than require WatchConnectivity. Companion apps can still cache workouts for temporary phone disconnection.
acceptance: Do not advertise independent installation until auth/data/recovery works without iOS.

requirement: Assign and retain a WCSession delegate and activate in both processes; transfer only after activated.
acceptance: Cold launch either app first; activation success/failure reaches correct UI state.

requirement: Implement iOS inactive/deactivate delegate handling and activate again for the new Watch.
acceptance: Switch Watches; stale device messages cannot mutate the new active session.

requirement: Check supported/paired/installed properties in valid lifecycle states; callbacks are on background queues; isolate UI mutations.
acceptance: Main-actor state updates, install/uninstall transitions and supported-device guards pass.

requirement: Use sendMessage for a reachable counterpart, with reply/error handling. Reachability is not an all-purpose sync permission.
acceptance: Disconnect between check/send; surface timeout and deduplicate retry.

requirement: Use updateApplicationContext for replaceable latest routine/settings state, not an event log.
acceptance: Rapid routine selections converge to the latest version without dropping completed-set events.

requirement: transferUserInfo supports background queued delivery; delivery is not immediate and must be tested on hardware.
acceptance: Background, offline, replay and process-restart acceptance tests pass.

requirement: Use transferFile only for suitable larger payloads; process files/errors correctly. Simulator does not support this transfer.
status: MISSING — only needed if files are transferred
acceptance: Verify received-file lifetime, size limits, completion and physical-device delivery.

requirement: Enable HealthKit only where used, check availability, supply read/write purpose strings and request relevant types.
acceptance: Authorized and unavailable/denied paths work without crashing or inventing measurements.

requirement: Read access denial cannot be inferred directly; a successful permission sheet does not prove all reads are authorized. Handle permission changes.
acceptance: Partial/denied/revoked access shows unavailable data, not fabricated zeros.

requirement: iOS/watchOS 27 adds limited-history behavior and getEarliestAuthorizedSampleDate. Availability-guard the API on older deployment targets; full and denied access are intentionally indistinguishable in its results.
acceptance: Queries respect per-type date bounds; trends disclose incomplete history; older OS path is tested.

requirement: Run HKWorkoutSession and HKLiveWorkoutBuilder with an appropriate activity/location configuration and data source.
acceptance: Start/paused/running/stopped/saved states match actual recording and workout type.

requirement: Live collection varies by configuration, settings and sensors. Do not infer automatically counted strength reps/weights from heart rate.
acceptance: Record available heart rate/energy and activity-relevant distance; preserve units/source and missing-data states.

requirement: startWatchApp wakes the Watch via WKApplicationDelegate.handle(_:) with a workout configuration; honor that configuration. Launch success alone is not recording acknowledgement.
acceptance: Explicit Start yields one confirmed Watch session; denied/not-installed/unreachable failures remain visible.

requirement: Watch primary session starts mirroring; iOS registers the mirroring start handler at launch. Mirroring is available from iOS 17/watchOS 10; custom routine/set/telemetry payloads still need an application protocol.
acceptance: Watch-first and phone-first launch both synchronize the same session.

requirement: The mirroring start handler may run multiple times with different session instances during reconnect; retain the logical workout identity.
acceptance: Reconnect does not create another workout or lose delegates/controls.

requirement: Remote data may arrive as arrays after suspension; iOS delivery can be minutes apart. Process every data object; avoid promises of continuous locked-phone updates.
acceptance: Suspended phone catches up; duplicate and out-of-order application events reconcile safely.

requirement: Enable Workout processing. Apple also specifies Audio background mode when the workout provides audio or haptic feedback. Keep CPU work bounded; excessive CPU can cause suspension.
acceptance: Wrist-down, phone-lock, interruptions and battery/CPU tests pass.

requirement: Handle active workout recovery, call recoverActiveWorkoutSession, and reattach builder/data source/delegates.
acceptance: Crash/relaunch restores the active workout without starting or saving a duplicate.

requirement: Use stopActivity, wait for stopped, successfully endCollection with the stopped date, finishWorkout, then session.end. A nil workout with nil error can mean a successful locked-device save; do not create a duplicate.
acceptance: Stop/end/save sequence and locked-device nil-success case persist one eventual HealthKit reference.

requirement: Protect health data, minimize collection, and describe its uses. Apple Health authorization and permission to upload to Forma are separate product concerns.
acceptance: Health permission, cloud sync, coach access, revocation/export/deletion boundaries explicitly tested.

requirement: Follow 5.1.3: accurate health data, explicit disclosure, no prohibited advertising/data-mining uses, and no personal health information stored by the app in iCloud.
acceptance: Review the actual data flow and App Store disclosures; keep sensor data outside generic coach exports.

requirement: Declare actual collection and required-reason API use in native app/SDK privacy manifests; validate the archive.
acceptance: All relevant targets/SDKs have accurate valid manifests; privacy report reviewed.

requirement: Since 28 April 2026 uploads require Xcode 26+ and corresponding 26+ SDKs. To compile 27-only APIs, use a toolchain with the 27 SDK. Deployment minimum is separate.
acceptance: Pin supported Xcode/macOS CI and archive with the required SDK.

requirement: The watchOS April 2026 requirement includes 64-bit support. Use Standard architectures; Ultra 2 supports arm64 under watchOS 26. Announcement was July 2025, requirement takes effect in 2026.
acceptance: Check archive slices and test simulator plus Ultra 2 hardware.

requirement: watchOS 27 notes deprecate WKExtension/WKExtensionDelegate for deployment targets 9.2+. Use modern app/WKApplicationDelegate lifecycle for the proposed new app.
acceptance: New native code uses supported lifecycle and recovery hooks.

requirement: Heart-rate/cycling-power zones are new HealthKit capabilities in OS 27. They are optional insights, not a prerequisite for connecting the Watch.
acceptance: If selected, confirm API availability, permission, supported metrics and older-OS fallback.

requirement: OS 27 release notes record a WidgetKit complication-transfer fix; only relevant if implementing complications.
acceptance: Validate selected WidgetKit update mechanism and supported OS versions on hardware.

requirement: Implement supported StartWorkoutIntent semantics if offering Action button launch; the wearer chooses its assignment.
acceptance: Configured button starts exactly one selected/default workout; permission/setup errors are recoverable.

requirement: Use reduced-cadence wrist-down UI, stop nonessential animation/subsecond work and respect sensitive content.
acceptance: Ultra 2 wrist-down/Always-On disabled/enabled cases remain readable and battery-conscious.

requirement: Prioritize current metrics and clear controls; validate VoiceOver, large text, contrast and touch interaction.
status: MISSING — responsive web UI is not Watch UI
acceptance: Real Watch tests for large text, VoiceOver, haptics, pause/end/discard and wet-hand interaction.

requirement: Apple’s mirrored-workout sample requires physical devices; simulator/browser tests cannot certify HealthKit sensing or queued Watch transfers.
acceptance: Paired iPhone/Ultra 2 matrix passes before claiming connected/working.

requirement: Persist account-bound command IDs, session/set identities, acknowledgements and offline queues. This is our application design inferred from delivery/recovery behavior, not a new Apple API requirement.
status: PARTIAL — server whole-workspace CAS exists; native event queue missing
acceptance: Replay/double-Start/concurrent complete-set/old-account queue tests preserve one correct session.

requirement: Apple device pairing does not authenticate the Forma account. Define native login/revocation, use protected credential storage such as Keychain, and bind durable device queues to the originating account.
acceptance: MFA/deep links, logout, switched accounts, lost device, offline queue rejection and credential revocation pass.
